text:
maya: flagged an odd post-launch regression on hyperion-9b (4-bit qlora build). short prompts are often ending in a repeated token sequence like 'OK OK OK' or an extra 'Click here' phrase. saw this on summarization and a couple of internal chat flows. dropping in quick numbers: rouge-L down ~6 pts vs fp16 baseline, code-gen pass@1 down ~3pts.

maya: config used: `qlora-4bit`, bitsandbytes 0.39, quant backend set to `bnb.4bit`. compilation flags: `--use-fused-attn=true` on A100 pools.

riya: can you paste a minimal repro prompt and an output? also which tokenizer version?

maya: repro prompt: 
```
User: Summarize the following minutes: "We approved the design. Next steps are implementation."
Assistant:
```
output (truncated): "Approved. OK OK OK. Click here for details."

alex: hmm that smells like a tokenization or logits-scaling mismatch. did you try running with `--disable-kv-cache` or `--disable-fused-attn`? also try tokenizer v2 from the model archive.

maya: tried `--disable-kv-cache` locally, still reproducible. haven't tried `--disable-fused-attn` yet. tokenizer is `tokenizer-v1` shipped in model tar.

samir: last week we hit a fused-attn kernel bug on A100 with 4-bit kernels where certain prompt shapes produced repeated tokens because of stray residuals in attention accumulators. H100 compiled kernels didn't show it. can you repro on h100?

maya: will try h100 now, running quick smoke.

(5m) maya: h100 run looks different — output is correct on h100. so likely a kernel mismatch on A100 runtime.

riya: ok that narrows it. samir, do we have a patch or known workaround?

samir: workaround: set `--use-fused-attn=false` or force use of the fallback attention kernel in the runtime. patch is in review for the fused-attn overflow guard but not merged. short-term we can route onboarded hyperion-9b 4-bit traffic to h100 pools or to an 8-bit fallback.

jeanne: for production we should: 1) open a post-launch incident ticket, 2) enable automatic fallback route to fp8/8bit variant, 3) add an eval case that exercises short-summary prompts and checks for repeated tokens. maya can you create the ticket with artifacts?

maya: creating ticket now and attaching reproductions, perf logs, and eval diffs. including these snippets:
```
[perf] seq_len=32 p50=12ms p95=45ms on A100 fused-attn
[eval] rouge-L: fp16=42.8 qlora-4bit=36.5
```

riya: also add tokenizer diff hashes (`tokenizer-v1` vs `tokenizer-v2`) and the exact model sha used for the compile. we need to rule out tokenizer alignment too.

samir: I'll try to push a canary runtime build with `--attn-guard` flag to the staging A100 pool, will post results. if the guard fixes it we can roll to prod quickly.

jeanne: assign to eng-ml-oncall and eng-runtime. set priority P1 for user-facing hallucinations on summarization flows.

maya: pinging @eng-ml-oncall in the ticket. also adding eval harness artifacts: seed, prompt set, raw logits dump.

alex: one more ask — do a short ablation: qlora-4bit + `--disable-fused-attn` vs qlora-4bit + `--disable-kv-cache` vs qlora-8bit. that will tell us if it's attention kernel vs quant numeric instability.

maya: running ablation now (will post CSV).

(1h) deploy-bot: Canary rollout triggered: hyperion-9b-fallback->8bit on A100 pool at 2028-03-12T21:14Z per `jeanne` request.

maya: ablation results: disabling fused-attn on A100 removes the repetition. 8-bit fallback also fine. kv-cache toggle had no effect. attaching CSV to ticket.

jeanne: great, plan: keep the 8-bit fallback routing live until samir's patch lands and we run full smoke across seq lengths. update the rollout notes and include a rollback playbook.

samir: will aim to get patch out in next 24-48h and post kernel test vectors. if anyone hits the thread with new reproductions, drop raw logits and `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` and hardware info. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — ticket link: TCK-4821, adding owners and artifacts.

alex: adding a short eval alert to console (watchlist) to trigger if repeated-token rate > 1% on production summaries.

riya: noted. I'll follow up with tokenizer re-checks tomorrow. :coffee:
